notes.title: Version 1.36
notes.notes:
A new update for Hyperplex 3D has been pushed!
For now it's mainly general improvements & bugfixes.

* Graphical improvements (Increased contrast, colors, tweaks)
* Made changes to lighting
* Game is no longer pauzeable when loading
* Removed post processing options: Color Grading. Permanent improvements have been applied to mitigate the need of these options.
* Fixed issues regarding screen resolutions. Where the settings menu would indicate wrong settings.
* Fixed issues that made it difficult to progress on level 98 and 107

notes.title: Version 1.33
notes.notes:
* When a song ends it will now automatically start a new one
* Added post-processing effects such as: Vignette, Lens Distortion and Color Grading
* Added options in menu to turn off post-processing
* Fixed bug in the editor that made it impossible to place tiles without getting a prompt to exit
* User interface that displays in levels is a bit smaller now
